hook: Procore's Magpie 3.0 engine successfully completed 78 percent of over 200 specialized construction industry tasks.

sections.voiceover: Procore's Magpie 3.0 engine successfully completed 78 percent of over 200 specialized construction industry tasks.
sections.visual_cue: Benchmark statistic graphic showing 78 percent task completion rate.

sections.voiceover: How did Procore's Magpie 3.0 outperform general-purpose frontier models during its recent construction AI benchmark?
sections.visual_cue: Timeline graphic displaying October 16 and October 22 dates.

sections.voiceover: General-purpose models only reached a 60 percent success rate on those same 200 construction tasks.
sections.visual_cue: Comparison bar chart showing Magpie at 78 percent versus general models at 60 percent.

sections.voiceover: Procore reported an 18 percentage point performance margin over the closest general-purpose frontier AI model. Procore previewed these results on its blog after showcasing the benchmark at Groundbreak 2026.
sections.visual_cue: Highlighted statistic showing 18 percentage point performance margin.

sections.voiceover: Procore released Magpie 3.0 in open beta on October 16, 2026.
sections.visual_cue: Final stat callout showing 78 percent success rate.
